# coolify_cloud_init_scripts (Data Source)

Lists Coolify team cloud-init scripts. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0. The script body is present only when the token can read sensitive values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_cloud_init_scripts" "all" {}

output "cloud_init_script_names" {
  value = [for s in data.coolify_cloud_init_scripts.all.scripts : s.name]
}
```
